references.text: The curtain shall separate the holy place from the Most Holy Place, and the ark of the testimony shall be placed behind the curtain.
Instructions for making the ark of the testimony, which was to contain the testimony (the tablets of the law).
Description of the curtain that was to cover the ark and separate the holy place from the Most Holy Place.
Fulfillment of the command: Moses placed the ark inside the tabernacle and hung up the curtain to shield the ark of the testimony.
When the camp breaks camp, Aaron and his sons shall cover the ark of the testimony with the curtain.
The Epistle to the Hebrews describes the Most Holy Place behind the second curtain, where the ark of the covenant stood, as a typological parallel to the tabernacle arrangement.
Hope as an anchor for the soul, reaching inside beyond the curtain—a reference to the Most Holy Place where the ark stood.
The verses together provide a complete mapping of the tent of meeting by placing the altar in front and the ark behind the separating curtain.
The verses together describe the two main components of the Most Holy Place: the mercy seat on the ark and the curtain that shields it.
The candidate verse describes the actual execution of the instruction given in the source verse, creating a direct narrative link between command and action.
The verses together define the hierarchical structure of the tent of meeting by placing the ark behind the curtain and other services outside it.
